subject: Library Construction Grant Application
overview: The Medford City Council approved an application for a state grant to construct a new public library and ordained the creation of the Community Preservation Committee. The Council also acted on several long-tabled items, approving a special permit for a Keno monitor after reconsideration.

items.title: Library Construction Grant Application
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution authorizing the city to apply for a state library construction grant and submit schematic designs for a new public library building.

items.title: Committee Reports on Tax Rate and Demolition Delay
items.summary: Adopted committee reports regarding the FY 2017 tax rate, Riverside Plaza design, and proposed amendments to the demolition delay ordinance.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Ordinance
items.summary: Ordained the Community Preservation Act ordinance establishing the Community Preservation Committee on third reading.

items.title: Commendations and Condolences
items.summary: Approved resolutions offering condolences for fallen Boston Police Officer DJ Simmonds, Joseph Bettinelli, and Jean Barry Sutherland, and commended the Jingle Bell Festival committee.

items.title: Swan Street Pothole Repairs
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting the Department of Public Works repair severe potholes on Swan Street to prevent damage to oil trucks.

items.title: Public Comment on Property Tax Calculation
items.summary: Resident Andrew Castagnetti presented calculations advocating for a residential tax exemption and discussed Proposition 2 1/2 growth limits.

items.title: Cleanup of Tabled Items
items.summary: Placed several long-tabled administrative items on file while requesting updates regarding business district kiosk funds and school bomb threat policies.

items.title: Special Permit for Keno Monitor at NK Convenience
items.summary: Approved a special permit for a Keno monitor at 562 High Street following a vote for reconsideration and discussion regarding city legal liability.
